title: Remove all authentication logic and make application fully public

requirements.text: Remove all Internet Identity authentication logic from the frontend including SignInScreen, SignInRequiredDialog, and all authentication-related components
acceptanceCriteria: SignInScreen component is removed or disabled
SignInRequiredDialog component is removed or disabled
No authentication prompts appear when accessing the application
Application loads directly to the dashboard without login

requirements.text: Remove AuthApprovalGate component or modify it to always render children without checking authentication or approval status

quotes: remove the logic of admin and users login

acceptanceCriteria: AuthApprovalGate no longer blocks access based on authentication
Application renders main content immediately without authentication checks
No approval screens or gates are shown to users

requirements.text: Remove useInternetIdentity hook dependencies and replace all authentication state checks with default authenticated state throughout the application

quotes: remove the logic of admin and users login

acceptanceCriteria: useInternetIdentity hook is no longer used in components
All isAuthenticated checks are removed or hardcoded to true
No authentication-related context providers wrap the application

requirements.text: Remove admin role checks, staff restrictions, and approval status checks from all components and hooks including useStaffRestrictions, useAppMode, and useApprovalStatus

quotes: remove the logic of admin and users login

acceptanceCriteria: All users can access bulk upload functionality
All users can perform delete operations
Admin-only routes and features are accessible to everyone
Access Management page is removed or accessible to all

requirements.text: Remove access control, user approval, and authentication mixins from backend/main.mo and disable all authentication checks in backend endpoints

quotes: remove the logic of admin and users login

acceptanceCriteria: Backend endpoints no longer require authentication
User approval system is removed from backend
Admin bootstrapping logic is removed
All backend methods are publicly accessible

requirements.text: Remove useMutationGate hook or modify it to always return mutations as ready without checking authentication state

quotes: remove the logic of admin and users login

acceptanceCriteria: All mutations are immediately available without authentication checks
useMutationGate no longer blocks mutations based on auth state
Components can perform mutations without authentication

requirements.text: Modify useActor hook to create backend actor instances without requiring Internet Identity authentication or admin token parameters

quotes: remove the logic of admin and users login

acceptanceCriteria: useActor hook creates actor without identity parameter
Admin token URL parameter is no longer used
Backend actor connects using anonymous identity or no authentication

requirements.text: Remove ApprovalRequiredScreen component and all approval request functionality from the frontend

quotes: remove the logic of admin and users login

acceptanceCriteria: ApprovalRequiredScreen is removed or never rendered
No approval request functionality exists
Users never see approval pending messages

requirements.text: Remove useBootstrapAdmin hook and all admin bootstrapping logic from the frontend

quotes: remove the logic of admin and users login

acceptanceCriteria: useBootstrapAdmin hook is removed or unused
No admin bootstrapping occurs on admin domains
Admin token handling is removed

requirements.text: Remove UserProfile data type and all user management endpoints from backend/main.mo including approval, profile, and admin check methods

quotes: remove the logic of admin and users login

acceptanceCriteria: UserProfile type is removed from backend
User approval endpoints no longer exist
Admin check methods are removed
User-related storage maps are removed

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts files directly - they are in immutablePaths
Do not introduce new authentication mechanisms while removing existing ones
Preserve all business logic for inventory, challans, payments, petty cash, and clients
Do not modify frontend/src/components/ui directory components
nonGoals: Fixing the existing backend connection errors shown in screenshots (connection failures are separate from authentication removal)
Adding new security mechanisms or access controls
Adding user registration or profile management features
Modifying the deployment configuration or canister settings
